Remove stale public audit and agent residue, narrow FCC claims to the evidence the repository actually proves, document the live-deployment provenance gap, and strengthen CI with pinned actions plus Flare signature compatibility checks.

Derive settled result via evaluator (REV-001); strip milestone vocabulary

REV-001 code portion: the proof scripts now derive the settled PayableResult
from a synthetic merchant record through an evaluator instead of asserting it
from constants.

- JorqethEvaluator: the confidential settlement rule (eligible earns
  floor(net*bps/10000); refunded or unmatched pay zero and mark ineligible; any
  class it cannot classify fails closed as INFRASTRUCTURE_UNKNOWN, never a
  payable outcome). toResult wires that output into the domain-bound result.
- SyntheticMerchantSource: a synthetic private order feed that reads each
  canonical record and its golden from the frozen spec.
- PositiveProof and NegativeProof derive the eligible (ORDER-A) and refund
  (ORDER-B) outcomes and settle those derived values, cross-checked against the
  spec golden before settlement.
- JorqethEvaluator.t.sol: 7 tests covering golden match for every order, floor
  rounding toward zero, and fail-closed on unknown class.

The derived amounts and eligibility codes equal the values the scripts
previously asserted, so the settlement figures in the regenerated evidence are
unchanged; only the proof-gate test count rises 61 to 68 for the new suite.

Also strip milestone and plan vocabulary (Milestone N, CP-00x, BLK-00x) from the
spec, contracts, proof scripts, evidence, web viewer, and docs, then regenerate
evidence and re-sync the site/data mirror byte-identical.

Verified: forge test 68 passed / 0 failed across 8 suites, forge fmt --check
clean, proof gate 9/9, all evidence and site/data mirror pairs byte-identical.

Close re-review items: escrow window, README claims, mobile marquee, fmt

Enforce disjoint settle/withdraw windows (REV-003): settle now rejects any
result whose expiry exceeds campaignEnd (ExpiryAfterCampaignEnd), so every
settleable result satisfies now < expiry <= campaignEnd and can never be
stranded by a withdrawal at campaignEnd. Add tests for the reject, the
inclusive boundary, and the withdraw-all-at-end case.

Correct root README overstatement (REV-004): drop "judge-ready", mark the
FCE, orchestrator, merchant API, and Coston2 contract as target design with a
"what runs today" line, and fix the stale test count to 61.

Keep the proof-strip pause control reachable below 560px instead of hiding it,
so the marquee never moves without an accessible way to stop it.

Reformat the two proof scripts so forge fmt --check passes.

Regenerate positive-proof and proof-gate evidence for the +349 gas from the
new expiry check and re-sync the site/data mirror byte-identical. Update
CHANGES_IMPLEMENTED.md to record the committed first round and this round.

Implement code review fixes and Hallmark UI pass

Contract and proof:
- Lock escrow until campaignEnd so a valid result always settles first (REV-003)
- Add withdrawal-lock invariants and boundary tests

Site:
- Add browser security headers and CSP in next.config.ts (REV-008)
- Fix 360px four-column grid clipping with a responsive .grid-4 (REV-005)
- Align public copy with the evidence, no overstated live claims (REV-004)
- Route colors through tokens, drop pure black/white surface
- Replace page-wide scroll reveal with a single first-load entrance
- Add keyboard-pausable ProofStrip, trim decorative eyebrows
- Rebuild footer as a proof-close with repository link and test-mode disclosure

Web and packaging:
- Confirm the browser smoke serves this checkout before asserting (REV-006)
- Add LICENSE, CI workflow, and an accurate site README (REV-007)

Docs:
- Add CODE_REVIEW.md and CHANGES_IMPLEMENTED.md

Add share cards, distinct route metadata, and UX polish

- Add 1200x630 OG image and wire openGraph.images plus an explicit
  twitter summary_large_image block into the root layout
- Give every app route a distinct title and description, and fix the
  title template so all app pages carry the consistent Jorqeth suffix
- Open footer external links in a new tab with noopener noreferrer
- Add an accessible label to the connected creator wallet chip
- Remove the hero honest-status paragraph and tidy nav CTA handling

Add Jorqeth product site: landing page and proof app

Next.js app (App Router, TypeScript) for the Jorqeth creator-commission
settlement product. Consumer-facing landing plus signed-in app screens
(dashboard, payout receipt, proof inspector, settlement matrix), all
rendered from the committed proof evidence with no mock data.

- Typed evidence layer over the real positive/negative/gate/spec JSON
- Jade/ink/cream design tokens, self-hosted fonts, dual logo + favicon
- Real Unsplash imagery, reduced-motion and focus-visible support
Package submission: add reproduction guide, evidence index, new-work disclosure, limitations, and roadmap to README
QA: make positive-proof settle block deterministic with --slow, regenerate evidence
QA: sync root README to proven state (55 tests, M3-M8) and normalize test formatting

Add judge-amplifying surfaces: settlement receipt, FCC proof inspector, product brief

Three read-only companion pages over the same committed proof and frozen spec.
No new write path, actor, or metric: each is another lens over the existing
evidence, bound through textContent only.

- receipt.html: shareable per-run receipt (eligible/refund/replay/infra),
  deep-linkable via ?r=, exact payout for eligible, zero for every other path
- inspector.html: five-step verification chain, the on-chain PayableResult
  fields the TEE signature binds, the private fields it withholds, honest
  simulated-vs-production attestation copy
- brief.html: target user, problem, guarantees, security controls, limitations
  (merchant-source first), new work vs inherited scaffold, three-step roadmap
- index.html: links to all three under 'Verify and understand it further'
- surfaces.js/surfaces-ctl.js: pure view-models + textContent-only controllers
- make [hidden] authoritative so conditional receipt rows hide correctly
- 27 unit tests + a browser smoke over all three surfaces

Add cold-start demo rehearsal runner

One-command, timed cold-start rehearsal for the judge demo path. Runs the
proof gate (fresh anvil, full forge suite, positive + negative on-chain
proofs, privacy scan -> 9/9) and drives the served judge page through the
complete run-of-show via the browser smoke walk. Exits 0 only when both
phases pass, so two consecutive clean runs can be verified from a known
clean state. No secrets, no live systems, no writes outside evidence/.

Add read-only judge page and harden proof-gate privacy scan

web/: a single, dependency-free page that replays the proven settlement
behaviour for a judge. Every figure is read at load time from the committed
positive/negative proof JSON, so the page cannot show a number the proof does
not contain. Values enter the DOM via textContent only (no injection surface).

- view.js: pure, framework-free view-model (15 node --test state tests)
- index.html + styles.css: one accessible page, 360px-safe, light/dark,
  visible focus, skip link, reduced-motion
- app.js: fetches evidence, binds the model, renders the negative matrix
- serve.mjs: zero-dep read-only static server (GET/HEAD, traversal-blocked)
- smoke.mjs: headless-browser smoke over both scenarios, mobile width,
  keyboard focus, evidence-link readback, rendered-DOM secret scan
- README.md: run/reproduce steps and honest replay-mode disclosure

evidence/run-proof-gate.sh: exclude the scanner's own source from the content
pattern classes. Once the scanner became a tracked file it matched its own
regex literals; the private-key class still scans it, so a real leak here is
still caught. Regenerated proof artifacts (block number only; amounts,
addresses, and gas unchanged).

M5: proof gate re-runs every core proof and resolves all 9 mandatory checklist items

Add evidence/run-proof-gate.sh: one command that boots a clean anvil, re-runs
the full forge suite (55/0) and both the positive and negative on-chain proofs,
best-effort re-derives the genuine tee-node signature vector, and privacy-scans
the committed public evidence. It maps each of the nine mandatory Proof Gate
Checklist items to evidence read back from its own source of truth and fails
loudly on any regression.

Emits evidence/proof-gate.{json,md}: result PASS, 9/9 items, privacy scan clean.
This is the plan's exit condition before any judge-facing UI work.

Add Milestone 4 negative and failure proofs

Mirror the positive proof against the same funded campaign with the real
FCC verifier installed: attempt 12 hostile or failure paths and prove
exactly one (the approved eligible order) moves value, moving exactly the
commission, while every other path pays zero and reverts for the expected
reason, with escrow provably intact and re-verifiable over RPC.

- NegativeProbe: try/catch harness so one tx records the whole matrix
- NegativeProof script + run-negative-proof.sh orchestrator + evidence bundle
- Pin ActionResult status to OK in FccResultVerifier (byte-faithful to
  tee-node v0.0.24): a genuinely signed error or timeout result whose Data
  decodes to a payable outcome now fails closed. Covered by two unit tests
  and an on-chain error_status vector.
- Distinguish a terminal refund (settled zero) from infra-unknown, fleet
  outage, and error status (reverted, retryable, digest not consumed)

forge test: 55 passed. Positive proof re-verified against the gate.

Add Milestone 3 positive proof: exact-commission settlement on-chain

Drive the full successful path as real on-chain transactions on a local
devnet (chainId 31337, the chain the genuine tee-node vector targets):
deploy the settlement with the real FccResultVerifier installed, fund one
campaign, and settle one eligible order signed by a registered TEE machine
under the frozen FCC ActionResult scheme.

- script/PositiveProof.s.sol: Forge broadcast script for the positive path;
  reverts unless the exact-payout invariant holds.
- evidence/run-positive-proof.sh: self-contained orchestrator (Foundry + jq).
  Boots anvil, broadcasts, reads state back over RPC, locates the settle/fund
  txs authoritatively from live event logs, and gates on a five-way
  exact-amount agreement.
- evidence/positive-proof.{json,md}: the committed, RPC-re-verifiable bundle.

Every independent source agrees at 20.000000 mUSD: configured formula, FCC
result amount, Settled event amount, creator balance delta, escrow delta.

Prove FCC verifier accepts a genuine Flare tee-node signature

Add tools/tee-signer, a self-contained Go module that mints a real Flare
Confidential Compute signature over a Jorqeth PayableResult using the pinned
Flare library code for every step (ActionResult.Hash, signing.Payload.Hash,
EIP-191 Sign), reproducing internal/router.SignResult line for line. The
committed genuine-vector.json is fully regenerable with `go run .`.

Add FccRealSignature.t.sol, which hardcodes that genuine vector and proves
FccResultVerifier.verify accepts it unchanged, that Solidity abi.encode(result)
equals the Go-produced Data byte for byte, and that the two signature landmines
a mock vm.sign hides are handled: v must be +27 normalized (raw v01 rejected)
and the signature is bound to the signer's chain id (wrong chain rejected).
Acceptance requires recovering the registered teeId; a tampered amount fails.

Also add two golden-vector checks in FccVerifier.t.sol pinning the payload hash
and TEE_ACTION_RESULT prefix to go-flare-common's own values, so CI catches any
drift from the TEE signing scheme with no Go toolchain required.

53 tests pass.

Add real FCC result verifier and swap it under settlement (M2, contract-side)

Reconstruct the exact hash the Flare TEE node signs over an ActionResult,
recover the secp256k1 signer, and accept a result only when that signer is a
currently-active teeId for Jorqeth's extension, read from the on-chain TEE
machine registry. Fail closed on an empty active set.

The signing scheme is frozen byte-for-byte from the pinned official sources
(tee-node, go-flare-common), so a genuine tee-node signature over
abi.encode(PayableResult) verifies unchanged. Attestation mode (simulated vs
production Confidential Space) is surfaced honestly through mode().

Swapping FccResultVerifier under JorqethSettlement changes nothing about the
settlement contract, its schema, or the M1 tests. Adds 14 tests (10 verifier,
4 settlement integration) proving an eligible order settles the exact
commission only on a registered-TEE signature, a valid non-TEE key is
rejected at the boundary, replay stays rejected, and removing the TEE halts
the payable path with escrow intact. 44 tests pass.

Enforce settlement invariant with injectable result verifier (M1)

Add the Jorqeth settlement core: merchant-funded escrow that releases the
exact floor commission for an eligible, domain-bound, non-replayed result and
pays zero on every negative, expired, wrong-domain, or unknown case.

- JorqethSettlement: escrow, static domain/schema binding, replay guard,
  checks-effects-interactions, fail-closed eligibility handling
- IResultVerifier boundary so the local signature verifier (M1) can be
  swapped for the Flare FCC verifier (M2) without touching settlement logic
- SignatureResultVerifier: EIP-712 signed result recovery (local-signature-v1)
- Frozen PayableResult schema, eligibility codes, floor rounding in spec
- MockUSD synthetic 6-decimal test token
- 30 tests: 10 golden vectors, 13 settlement invariants, 5 commission math,
  2 verifier mode/guard checks; all passing

Testnet and synthetic data only. FCC not yet integrated (M2).
